Little steps. Big adventures.

Run & learn

Move with ← →, A / D, the on-screen arrows, or tap a question sign in its lane. Space or P pauses. Space also continues after a wrong answer. Select a lane before the gate reaches your pet. Dodge large crates, delivery carts and striped barriers by moving to another lane. A collision costs one heart; press Space to continue. Obstacles never appear during questions or coin rushes.

Is there any…? for uncountable food.
Are there any…? for plural countable food.

First, a food picture and name pop up for 2 seconds. Then the answer gates appear in the lanes. Gates take 5 seconds to arrive and gradually slow down. Every 5 correct answers unlocks a 3-second night-market coin rush. Pause also pauses the bonus clock.

Care & grow

Each run earns growth XP equal to half its earned coins. Finish through the pause menu or use all three hearts. Tap your pet for 1 XP, up to 10 times per local calendar day.

Buy food to restore fullness. Play to improve happiness. Buy a reusable cleaning brush for 40 coins; clean each mess for +8 happiness. A mess appears every 3 hours, with up to 6 waiting at once. Food and happiness gradually decrease while you are away.

An egg can wear accessories and enjoy care too. Each pet has its own baby, junior, adult and magical radiant illustration.

Pet tricks

Buy Jump, Twirl or Happy Dance in the Actions shop. Use the buttons in your pet room to perform them. Your pet also surprises you with its learned tricks from time to time. Eggs can do a little wiggle too!

Your saves

Use My games to start a new adventure or continue one of up to three saves. Each card shows the pet, growth stage, XP and coins. If all three slots are full, delete one with confirmation before starting another. Keep a backup if you move devices or clear browser data.
